items.l1: It is gratifying that in recent years some places have brought dialect nursery rhymes and local opera into schools, letting children come into contact with their native dialect again through games and chanting.
items.notes: Faithful; low score is synonym spread (值得/令人欣慰, 引入/引进, 乡音/家乡方言), no meaning gap.

items.l1: In the recruitment market, age discrimination often appears in hidden forms.
items.notes: 'Job market' pointed to 求职/就业市场 rather than gold 招聘市场 (employer side, matching the next sentence); changed to 'recruitment market'.

items.l1: In fact, there is no better or worse between stability and risk-taking.
items.notes: Faithful; 高下 vs 优劣 and 事实上 vs 其实 are interchangeable renderings, so several golds fit.

items.l1: In the mild group, A's cure rate is 90% and B's is 85%; in the severe group, A's is 60% and B's is 50%.
items.notes: All four numbers exact; low score is only because gold names the therapies 甲/乙, and A/B is the standard English form (set in the previous sentence).

items.l1: While keeping accounts, Xiao Lin studied customers' tastes, and also learned to use social media to announce his stall hours.
items.notes: Faithful; differences are 公布/发布 and a possessive English requires; blind back-translation was near-identical to gold.

items.l1: Therefore, many companies simply use the two in combination, each taking its own strengths.
items.notes: Faithful; 索性/干脆 and 二者/两者 are synonyms, and 各取所长 came straight back from the reference.

items.l1: Arranging to have hotpot with a few good friends on the weekend should have been something to look forward to, but once everyone's spice tolerance was laid on the table, the atmosphere turned subtle.
items.notes: Faithful; spread is lexical (相约/约, 本是/本该, 辣度承受力/吃辣程度, 当/一旦), with the same contrast and facts.

items.l1: The choices at the dipping-sauce counter are equally intriguing: those who love spice scoop on chilli and minced garlic layer upon layer, as if afraid the flavour would not be enough; those who prefer mild food add only a little sesame oil and spring onion, striving to preserve the original taste of the ingredients.
items.notes: Faithful clause for clause; gold is literary (取舍, 嗜辣者, 清淡者, 本味), and the plain equivalents are equally valid.

items.l1: At the table there was the occasional good-natured teasing, saying that differences in taste have nothing to do with being better or worse, and are merely a matter of each person's taste-bud memories being different.
items.notes: Reference dropped 各自 ('each person's') and narrowed 无关高下 to 'superiority'; restored both.

items.l1: What is called compatibility perhaps lies not in having completely identical tastes, but in being willing to leave room for half a pot of clear broth for each other.
items.notes: Faithful; 投缘/合得来 and 一致/相同 are synonym choices, and 'for each other' covers 彼此…对方.

items.l1: Compared with being jostled by crowds at famous attractions, more and more people prefer to drive themselves to small towns two or three hours away by car, slowing their steps down.
items.notes: Faithful, numbers kept; spread is 知名/著名, 人挤人/挤来挤去, 前往/到; 'by car' is redundant in English but not a meaning change.

items.l1: However, price is not determined by area alone; location, floor and building age are equally important, and a single line inevitably falls short by being too simplistic.
items.notes: Faithful; 举足轻重 as 'equally important' and 失之简略 as 'too simplistic' fit within the gold's meaning; the gap is idiom vs plain wording.

items.l1: If you are temporarily unemployed, you can pay on your own as a flexibly employed person, so that your length of service and account balance do not develop a break.
items.notes: Faithful; 待业/失业, 以免/使…不, 断层/断档 are near-synonyms, and 'length of service' correctly gives 工龄.

items.l1: After nightfall the lantern fair takes over the shift, and strings of lanterns spread all the way along the river embankment and the old street, their reflections breaking into shimmering gold on the water.
items.notes: Faithful image by image; the spread is descriptive vocabulary (成串/一串串, 铺展/铺开, 晃动的金色/粼粼金光).

items.l1: If two sets of scores have the same mean, with one set of scores concentrated near the mean and the other widely varying from high to low, then it is hard to tell which is better from the mean alone.
items.notes: Faithful; gold alternates 均值/平均数, which English 'mean' cannot mark, and 分辨二者的优劣 = 'tell which is better'.

items.l1: Once inside the scenic area, so-called sightseeing is more like being pushed forward by the crowd: the viewing platform is shoulder to shoulder, taking a single photo means queuing for half a day, a sea of people, every step difficult.
items.notes: Faithful; spread is 游览/观光 and 举步维艰/寸步难行; gold uses half-width punctuation, a formatting quirk only and not broken.

items.l1: Some split the holiday into two parts and go at off-peak times; some give up internet-famous attractions and turn to small towns and villages that are not very famous but have quiet, beautiful scenery.
items.notes: Faithful; 小城与村落 vs 小镇和村庄 and 前往/出行 are synonym spread; gold punctuation is half-width, not broken.

items.l1: For a comment like "beautifully packaged, but delivery is too slow", a person can read the praise and criticism at a glance, but a machine finds it hard to process directly.
items.notes: Faithful; 精美/漂亮 and 物流/发货 are equally valid renderings of the quoted comment, and the structure matches.

items.l1: According to the old custom, Mother will quietly wrap a washed coin inside one of the dumplings.
items.notes: Faithful in every element; the 0.44 is a short sentence where every word has a synonym (规矩/习俗, 母亲/妈妈, 裹/包, 只/个).

items.l1: Whoever bites into it is regarded as the most fortunate person in the coming year.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's literary 若…便/视作 vs colloquial 谁…就/认为 explains the low score, and the meaning is identical.
